name: thumb_ahamo_dec_1
prompt: Vertical 9:16 YouTube Shorts thumbnail in the style of a bold Japanese tech-news magazine cover. All Japanese text perfectly spelled exactly as given, no other text, no real brand logos, no watermark. No tiny decorative patterns or sparkles. Colors: dark navy with glowing cyan and blue neon. Scene: the girl, surprised face with wide eyes, holds up a big smartphone toward the viewer; behind her a huge glowing staircase of three rising price blocks (small, medium, large) like a giant bar chart.
